# colter.dev

> Colter Dahlberg's personal hub — Systems Engineering · AI · Open Source.

Colter Dahlberg builds systems, AI, and open-source software. This site is a personal hub: it links to his services, pins two featured projects, and lists his most-recently-updated GitHub repositories. It runs as a Cloudflare Worker + Static Assets (vanilla JS, no framework, Lexend font).

## Featured projects
- emily (private): "We're stuck at 'agentic.' Emily is what comes after." — research toward autonomous/general AI beyond "agentic" (Level 2.5). Grounded in Morris et al. 2023, "Levels of AGI" (https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.02462) and Feng et al. 2025, "Levels of Autonomy for AI Agents" (https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.12469).
- coco (private): a coding agent that ships itself. A Rust platform that self-hosts its own releases.

## Services
- OmniRoute: https://llm.colter.dev — one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, every model.
- Colter+: https://colter.plus — self-hosted streaming library.
